name: Cone-Footprint LOD and Step Sizing
definition: A technique replacing fixed step counts with sample density proportional to screen content (cone footprint) rather than camera distance, to reduce stationary-shimmer/aliasing.
summary: Cone-Footprint LOD and Step Sizing replaces fixed steps with sample density proportional to screen-space voxel footprints, reducing aliasing by dynamically matching sampling rates to projected pixel areas.
